title: Synonymix: Unified Group Personas for Generative Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the fidelity of synthetic agents by comparing their response distributions on 108 General Social Survey (GSS) items. The paper measures 'enrichment distance' (the difference between agents prompted with demographic-only seeds versus rich narrative life stories) to quantify how well the system mitigates the LLM's tendency to produce flattened demographic caricatures.
